ctx.x: How did you get to make the records? Did they see you perform.

Yeah. Probably 52nd Street I guess, I don't know, just word-of-mouth. He came in town because Herb was with National Records and he got him because he knew -- Herb Abrams knows recording backwards. So the other fella had the money. But anyhow we got this date started
and I did the date and forgot all about it -- was called "Old Black Magic" I think was one of the records. ---
